outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command: cd /app && ls -la && wc -l input.csv expected.csv && head -5 input.csv && echo "---EXPECTED---" && head -5 expected.csv
cd /app && sed -n '1,20p' input.csv | cat -A && echo "---EXPECTED---" && sed -n '1,20p' expected.csv | cat -A

cd /app && awk -F',' 'NF!=3 {print NR": "$0; c++} END{print "bad_field_count="c+0}' input.csv | head -20 && echo "---" && awk -F',' 'NF!=4 {print NR": "$0; c++} END{print "expected_bad="c+0}' expected.csv | head -20 && echo "--- trailing/newline check ---" && tail -c 50 input.csv | cat -A && tail -c 50 expected.csv | cat -A

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
with open('input.csv', newline='') as fi, open('expected.csv', newline='') as fe:
    for i,(li,le) in enumerate(zip(fi,fe),1):
        parts=[p.strip() for p in li.rstrip('\n').split(',')]
        got=';'.join([parts[2].upper(),parts[1].upper(),parts[0].upper(),'OK'])+'\n'
        if got!=le:
            print('mismatch',i,repr(li),repr(le),repr(got)); break
    else:
        print('all match')
PY

cd /app && cat > /tmp/test_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\<CR>gUU:s/,/;/g\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "A;OK\<Esc>")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
wq
VIM
cp input.csv /tmp/test.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/test.csv -S /tmp/test_macros.vim
echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/test.csv expected.csv && echo MATCH || { echo MISMATCH; head -5 /tmp/test.csv; }

cd /app && cat > apply_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\<CR>gUU:s/,/;/g\<CR>")
call setreg('b', "A;OK\<Esc>")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
cp input.csv /tmp/input.orig.csv
cat -A apply_macros.vim
echo "--- running ---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim
echo "exit=$?"
cmp /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv && echo BYTE_MATCH || echo NOT_MATCH

cd /app && echo "Script lines:" && nl -ba apply_macros.vim && echo "--- validation ---" && awk '!/^call setreg\('\''[abc]'\'', ".*"\)$/ && !/^:%normal! @[abc]$/ && !/^:wq$/ {print "DISALLOWED: "$0; bad=1} END{if(!bad) print "all lines allowed"}' apply_macros.vim && echo "--- final check ---" && cmp input.csv expected.csv && echo "input.csv == expected.csv" && wc -c input.csv expected.csv
